_about: Which Pokemon Journeys overworld sheet (assets/dungeon/characters, dev/builders/import_dungeon_sprites.py) is whose on the dungeon map. trainers: by battle sprite (Journeys' trchar### numbers follow its PBS trainertypes.txt); pokemon: species -> [sheet, column] (the Pokemon sheets: a column a Pokemon, a row a way it faces); figures: a route button by "AREA:TEXT" -> {sheet} or {item} or {pokemon}; townsperson: anyone else. A trainer or Pokemon left out keeps its battle sprite or party icon. players: your trainer by character (girls: who walks as the girl's sheet; anyone else as the boy's).
